violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. -Both sani buckets found at 0ppm Chlorine solutions. *Corrected on-site. Buckets were remade to 100ppm Chlorine solutions.--In-use utensil was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. -Plastic fork used for customer self-serve submerged in pickles. *Staff voluntarily disposed of product and stocked new container with different (larger) utensil.

General equipment and utensils - Use limitations of certain materials. — --Material of food contact equipment/utensil did not meet durability characteristics or are a limited use material. -Single use plastic cups left in dry snacks to be used as scoops. *Should be a scoop with a handle, with handle stored out of product.

Preventing contamination of packaged and unpackaged food. — --Raw animal food was not properly separated from raw or cooked ready-to-eat food. -Tubes of raw hamburger stored on bottom shelf above drawers of bagged coleslaw and whole bell peppers.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. -Sani bucket found at greater 200+ppm chlorine solution.
Cleaning frequency, maintained clean (1 pt deducted)
Clean, proper use, storage, sanitizing solution (2 pts deducted)
Hot holding and cold holding temperatures maintained, unwrapped food not reserved (5 pts deducted)
Date marking accomplished, discarded (2 pts deducted)
